name: Morvella
summary: Morvella combines the richness of half leather with refined craftsmanship, its headboard and footboard accented by diagonal grain detailing that lends a sense of rhythm and structure. Slender stainless steel legs in a warm brass finish elevate the form with a touch of radiance. Confident and composed, it embodies contemporary luxury shaped by texture, proportion, and elegance. 285x226x112(180×200)
